instructions: This is a Vite + React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind 3 site.
Pages: Home, Services, Work, About, Contact, 404 — all in src/pages/.
Data is hardcoded in src/data/site.ts — no CMS.
Follow existing patterns: PageHero + SectionHeading components for page layout.
Use lucide-react for icons. Use cn() from lib/utils for className merging.
No new dependencies without explicit approval.
Always verify with npm run build after changes.
